method.label: Bound the sum and reach it

annotationRationale: A universal upper bound rules out 20 or fewer terms, and an explicit construction attains 21 terms.
sourceMethod: Follows the official bound using the largest two-digit number, followed by the construction with twenty 99s and one 44.

review.mathCheck: At most 20 two-digit terms sum to at most 20·99=1980<2024. The construction 2024=20·99+44 uses 21 valid terms, proving the minimum is 21, choice B.
review.sourceMethodCheck: Faithful, independently worded adaptation of official Q4 on page 3, retaining both the universal bound and an attaining construction.
review.annotationCheck: The sole assessed concept directly matches both parts of the proof; no material prerequisite annotation is missing.
